title: Classes, modules, and method lookup
outcome: Find which method runs before changing an inheritance or mixin chain.
book: Language ch. 7–8; Eloquent Ruby ch. 16; Metaprogramming Ruby Monday
cue: Follow the receiver, then the lookup path.

exercises.title: Find and fix the bug
exercises.prompt: An audit wrapper is included into a class that already defines save_label. Its wrapper never runs. Show a lookup-based explanation and two possible repairs.

exercises.title: Change one condition
exercises.prompt: Three subclasses must have independent configuration. Why can @@options be dangerous?

trace.title: Receiver
trace.detail: Every ordinary Ruby method call has a receiver. self is the current receiver. An instance method lives on a class or module; each instance supplies its own instance variables. A class is also an object, so def self.build defines a singleton method on that class object.

trace.title: Follow the middle steps
trace.detail:
For prepend, begin at the wrapper module. Its super calls the next matching implementation, Task#label. With include, the class method normally wins before the included module.

To debug a surprising method, inspect obj.method(:name).owner and .source_location. Inspect Class.ancestors for included/prepended modules. This turns “Ruby magic” into a path you can follow.

trace.title: Check the result
trace.detail: A concern can quietly add callbacks and class methods. Naming a module does not isolate its side effects. A singleton method defined on one object does not automatically become an instance method for every object.

recallPrompt: Without notes: Find which method runs before changing an inheritance or mixin chain. Give a concrete failure example.
